# scripts/Combat/Thrown.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Combat/Thrown.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Damage rider for a guard-thrown RigidBody3D. launch() attaches the rider and
sets the body velocity; each victim can be hit once. The rider frees itself
after 4 s or after 0.3 s once speed falls below HARMLESS_SPEED.

Base: `Node3D`. Registered class: `none`.

## Functions

### launch

```gdscript
static func launch(item: RigidBody3D, by: Node3D, velocity: Vector3, hit_damage: float) -> Node3D
```

[Source:24](../../../../../scripts/Combat/Thrown.gd#L24)

Attaches a damage rider to item and sets its world linear/random angular velocity.
Returns the rider Node3D; by is the excluded thrower and hit_damage is base damage.

| Parameter | Type in source | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `item` | `RigidBody3D` | required |
| `by` | `Node3D` | required |
| `velocity` | `Vector3` | required |
| `hit_damage` | `float` | required |

Return type: `Node3D`.
